description: For eleven AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others): allowed or blocked for the page's path under robots.txt, plus the noai and noimageai opt-outs in meta and X-Robots-Tag, and whether llms.txt exists.
